status: declared by the pull request that closes #473, before any rule was scored. A measurement, not a candidate: nothing here joins the pressure-day judge's candidate list or the published declaration. The rule below is a calendar and settlement upper bound, and the audit reads the judge's own bar (metadata/pressure_judge.json) unchanged.

scoring.note: the judge's scored days (2018-06-29 to 2025-12-31); no 2026 day is read (docs/decisions/lockbox.md)

rule.description: Warn on scored day T when any enabled clause holds. Every clause is a fact about T that is public at the decision instant: the calendar columns are always known, and a settlement is public at 15:00 on the panel day before it (docs/decisions/information-set.md, rule 2), so the settlement clause is available at horizon 1 only.

month_end_window.note: null switches the clause off; N warns when days_to_month_end <= N

settlement.note: null switches the clause off; USD billions of gross Treasury settlement on T

variants.calendar: the settlement clause is off at every horizon
variants.calendar_settlement: the settlement clause is on at horizon 1 and off at horizons 2 to 5

rule.choice: at each refit and horizon the combination of clauses with the highest onset recall whose false alarms per onset on the refit's training window are at most the judge's limit (metadata/pressure_judge.json, cutoff_rule); of combinations with the same recall, the one that flags the fewest days of the window, then the first in the declared order of the clauses (quarter_end, tax_date, month_end_window, settlement, each from the switched-off value to the loosest)
rule.training_window: the judge's: the scored days up to the business day before the block's first decision instant, from the first scored day (pressure_judge.choose_cutoffs)

scored.tier_1: pressure_judge._onset_tier on the rule's flags, at lead >= 1 to 5 and at each horizon alone, against calendar climatology at the same false alarms; by calendar year
